## Claims
- [proved] Let \(\Lambda=\bigoplus_\lambda\mathbb Zs_\lambda\), \(I_{r,q}:=\bigoplus_{\lambda\nsubseteq q^r}\mathbb Zs_\lambda\), and \(A_{r,q}:=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\). For \(0\le i\le q\), \(0\le j\le r\), define
  \[
  J_{r,q;i,j}:=\bigoplus_{\,i^j\subseteq\lambda\subseteq q^r}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda\subseteq A_{r,q}.
  \]
  This is an ideal: in every nonzero Littlewood–Richardson term \(s_\lambda s_\nu=\sum_\rho c_{\lambda\nu}^\rho s_\rho\), one has \(\lambda\subseteq\rho\); hence every surviving \(\rho\) still contains \(i^j\). Let \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\). Since \(\lambda\subseteq q^r\iff\lambda'\subseteq r^q\), \(\omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}\), so it induces an integral ring isomorphism
  \[
  \bar\omega_{r,q}:A_{r,q}\xrightarrow{\sim}A_{q,r},
  \qquad\bar s_\lambda\mapsto\bar s_{\lambda'}.
  \]
  For every \(\lambda\subseteq q^r\),
  \[
  i^j\subseteq\lambda\iff j^i\subseteq\lambda'.
  \]
  Indeed, for \(i,j>0\), the left side says \(\lambda_a\ge i\) for \(1\le a\le j\), equivalently \(\lambda'_b=\#\{a:\lambda_a\ge b\}\ge j\) for \(1\le b\le i\), which is \(j^i\subseteq\lambda'\). If \(i=0\) or \(j=0\), both rectangles are empty and the equivalence is vacuous. Thus \(\bar\omega_{r,q}\) maps the displayed \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(J_{r,q;i,j}\) bijectively to the displayed \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(J_{q,r;j,i}\). Therefore
  \[
  \boxed{\bar\omega_{r,q}(J_{r,q;i,j})=J_{q,r;j,i}}.
  \]
  The missing basiswise interval-ideal certificate is established.

## Strategy
Transpose the Schur basis and verify lower-rectangle containment directly by partition coordinates.

## Gaps
None for this basiswise interval-ideal equality. Transformed-bigrassmannian admissibility and minimality are outside this certificate.
